description: mix-blend-mode and background-blend-mode as Chromium composites them (docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, blending): each of the 16 mix-blend-mode values other than normal over a solid colour, translucent over a gradient and over a public/ image; opacity with a blend; a multiply inside a screen-blended box; a multiply-blended box inside ancestors that isolate it (isolation, opacity, transform, z-index) and ones that do not (none, overflow hidden, rounded overflow), and a z-indexed child hoisted out of an overflow clip; blended text and a blended box with text; shadcn-svelte's avatar ring (an in a rounded span whose ::after border is mix-blend-mode: darken, and lighten on a dark background); background-blend-mode over a colour and with two layers. Every blended box is a pixel region
